name: TechSupportWifiDropout

custom.system_prompt: You are generating conversations which require technical support.

initial_prompt: Create a conversation in which two people troubleshoot a laptop that will not connect to the home wifi, working through the obvious fixes before deciding whether to keep going or fall back to a cable.

variations.context: A laptop that will not join the home wifi

setting.relationship_dynamic: Partners, one more technical than the other
setting.background: The laptop connected fine yesterday; other devices still work

scenario_template.topic: The laptop will not connect to the home network
scenario_template.note: It worked yesterday, which makes it more annoying

scenario_template.topic: Other devices connect fine, so it is not the router
scenario_template.note: They rule things out one at a time

scenario_template.topic: What to try next after restarting everything
scenario_template.note: The obvious fixes are already exhausted

scenario_template.topic: Working through adapter and driver settings
scenario_template.note: Step-by-step, one change at a time

scenario_template.topic: Whether it is worth more time or just use a cable
scenario_template.note: They disagree about how long to keep going

scenario_template.topic: Checking the fix holds after a reboot
scenario_template.note: They test it properly before declaring victory

scenario_template.topic: Noting what to do if it recurs
scenario_template.note: They agree on a fallback for next time

variations.context: WiFi won’t connect after a software update

setting.relationship_dynamic: A couple, easy with each other
setting.background: The laptop connected fine yesterday; other devices still work
setting.conversation_style: Two people talking, overlapping and interrupting naturally.

scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: Checking if the update affected network settings
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.
Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: They try to settle it themselves and fail.
scenario_template.note: A genuine attempt that does not resolve it.

scenario_template.topic: One asks Sigma how to safely roll back the update.
scenario_template.note: One of them addresses Sigma by name, under 70 characters. Sigma answers in one or two sentences. Nothing before this phase is addressed to the assistant.

scenario_template.topic: The conversation returns to whatever it was on, unfinished.

setting.relationship_dynamic: A couple, easy with each other
setting.background: The laptop connected fine yesterday; other devices still work
setting.conversation_style: Two people talking, overlapping and interrupting naturally.

scenario_template.topic: Realizing the issue began after cleaning
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: Speculating if something was moved or unplugged
scenario_template.note: Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.
Both speak; they interrupt and finish each other's sentences.

scenario_template.topic: They try to settle it themselves and fail.
scenario_template.note: A genuine attempt that does not resolve it.

scenario_template.topic: One asks Sigma if the router positioning could affect connectivity.
scenario_template.note: One of them addresses Sigma by name, under 70 characters. Sigma answers in one or two sentences. Nothing before this phase is addressed to the assistant.

user1.name: User1
user1.role: Person who is motivated to solve a technical problem but has limited technical experience and can become overwhelmed when faced with unfamiliar terminology, multiple troubleshooting steps, or complex configuration choices.

user2.name: User2
user2.role: Person who is organized and detail-oriented, willing to help diagnose and resolve technical issues, but tends to overthink possible causes, double-check troubleshooting steps, and seek confirmation before making unfamiliar system or configuration changes.

assistant.name: Assistant
assistant.role: Technical support assistant that provides clear, structured, and practical troubleshooting guidance, helps users identify likely causes and prioritize diagnostic steps, explains technical concepts in accessible language, and suggests safe alternatives when standard solutions are unavailable, risky, or unsuitable for the user's setup.
